cohort: 707 pregnant patients undergoing expectant management at greater than 39 weeks' gestation
finding: Maternal characteristics, including BMI, parity, substance use, and third trimester cervical dilation, were not accurate predictors of spontaneous labor onset at ≥39 weeks' gestation.
mod_finding: Patients who went into spontaneous labor had lower odds of cesarean delivery and neonatal intensive care unit admission.
